connector.name: Creator SKILL - Influencer Discovery
connector.registryDescription: AI influencer search on TikTok, Instagram, YouTube. Deinai MCP token required; credits per result.
connector.summary: Hosted at deinai.ai over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the Python package deinai-mcp. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace ai.deinai, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer MCP JWT from POST https://deinai.ai/api/v1/mcp/tokens (user login JWT required to create).

env.description: MCP JWT from Deinai token API
